name: SMWFileProtect
author: Toni Hermoso Pulido <toniher@cau.cat>
description: Protects files and namespaces in Semantic MediaWiki based on user rights and properties.

SMWFileProtectRights.description: User groups that can always read files, whatever pages use them.

SMWFileProtectReferNS.description: Deny a file if a page using it is in a namespace the user cannot read under Lockdown.

SMWFileProtectReferSMW.description: Also deny a file based on the SMWFileProtectReferUsers and SMWFileProtectReferProps properties of the pages using it.

SMWFileProtectReferUsers.description: Properties listing the users allowed to read the files used on a page.

SMWFileProtectReferProps.description: Boolean properties that must be true on a page for its files to be readable.
